capabilities: Generate Anki cards from note text using #card tags, :: separators, and cloze syntax
Insert, update, and delete Anki cards from the current file or the whole vault
Support LaTeX, images, audio, note references, and code syntax highlighting in cards
Migrate notes from the original Flashcards plugin while keeping Anki review history
disambiguation: It does not offer in-Obsidian flashcard review; it only generates and syncs cards to Anki.
extras: Detailed usage instructions are kept in a separate wiki rather than the README; the README includes a migration guide warning that mismatched settings can create duplicate Anki cards.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of reuseman/flashcards-obsidian, originally by Alex Colucci and Noah Rousell, with bug fixes and small tweaks
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note text into Anki cards, so users must retype or manually export their flashcards.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of reuseman/flashcards-obsidian
sends card content to Anki on your machine via AnkiConnect

summary: Fork of the Flashcards plugin that syncs Obsidian flashcards to Anki using tags, inline separators, and cloze syntax.
